mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.name, s.type, s.difficulty, s.duration, s.player_count, s.description, s.cover_url, s.dm_id, s.created_at, ROUND(AVG(r.script_rating)::numeric, 1) as avg_script_rating, COUNT(r.id) as review_count FROM scripts s LEFT JOIN reviews r ON s.id = r.script_id GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.type, s.difficulty, s.duration, s.player_count, s.description, s.cover_url, s.dm_id, s.created_at ORDER BY s.created_at DESC

SELECT s.id, s.name, s.type, s.difficulty, s.duration, s.player_count, s.description, s.cover_url, s.dm_id, s.created_at, ROUND(AVG(r.script_rating)::numeric, 1) as avg_script_rating, COUNT(r.id) as review_count FROM scripts s LEFT JOIN reviews r ON s.id = r.script_id WHERE s.id = #{id} GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.type, s.difficulty, s.duration, s.player_count, s.description, s.cover_url, s.dm_id, s.created_at
